With a customer base of over 19 million, and a large network of remittance partners around the world, Federal Bank handles more than one fifth of India's total personal inward remittances, approximately. The bank has remittance arrangements with more than 110 banks and exchange companies around the world.{{cite web |url=https://currentaffairs.adda247.com/federal-bank-installs-100-kwp-solar-plant-at-aluva-office |title=Federal Bank installs 100 KWp solar plant at Aluva office |website=adda247.com |date=2023-02-24 |access-date=2023-09-02}} The bank is also listed in the [[Bombay Stock Exchange]], [[National Stock Exchange of India]] and [[London Stock Exchange]] and has a branch in India's first International Financial Services Centre (IFSC) at the [[GIFT City]]. == History == The Federal Bank Limited (the erstwhile Travancore Federal Bank Limited) was incorporated with an authorised capital of {{INR|5000}} at [[Nedumpuram]], a place near [[Thiruvalla]] in Central Travancore on 23 April 1931 under the Travancore Companies Act. It started business of auction-chitty and other banking transactions connected with agriculture and industry.{{Cite book |last=Joseph |first=Kalarickal P. |url=https://books.google.com/books?id=S1gWAQAAMAAJ&q=auction-chitty |title=Hormis: Legend of a Great Banker with Passion for Development : Biography of K.P. Hormis, Founder of Federal Bank |date=2005 |publisher=D.C. Books |isbn=978-81-264-1117-7 |language=en}} The bank was named Federal Bank Limited on 2 December 1949, after completing the formalities of [[Banking Regulation Act, 1949]]. It is considered as one of the major Indian commercial banks in the private sector having more than thousand branches and ATMs spread across different States in India. Between 1963 and 1970, Federal Bank took over Chalakudy Public Bank (est. 20 July 1929 in [[Chalakudy]]), Cochin Union Bank (est. 1963) in [[Thrissur]], Alleppey Bank (est. 1964; [[Alappuzha]]), St. George Union Bank (est. 1965) in Puthenpally, and Marthandam Commercial Bank (est. 1968) in [[Thiruvananthapuram]]. The bank launched its initial public offering in 1994.{{cite web |title=Federal Bank's first IPO |url=https://www.business-standard.com/company/federal-bank-3709.html}} The bank became a Scheduled Commercial Bank in 1970, which also coincided with the Silver Jubilee Year, since the bank commenced its operation in [[Aluva]]. In January 2008, Federal Bank opened its first overseas representative office in [[Abu Dhabi]]. In November 2016, Federal Bank opened its second [[United Arab Emirates|UAE]] representative office, in [[Dubai]].{{cite web |title=Dubai Rep Office |date=14 November 2016 |url=https://www.thehindubusinessline.com/money-and-banking/federal-bank-to-open-its-first-overseas-branch-in-dubai/article9344179.ece}}{{cite web|title=Federal Bank to expand overseas footprints|url=http://www.khaleejtimes.com/business/federal-bank-to-expand-overseas-footprints}} == Subsidiary companies == *Federal Operations and Services Limited (Fedserv) {{Cite web |title=Fed Serv:We aim for quality because only perfect quality can give perfect satisfaction.. |url=http://www.fedserv.co.in/ |access-date=2024-01-09 |website=www.fedserv.co.in |archive-date=29 November 2023 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20231129020646/http://fedserv.co.in/ |url-status=dead }} is a wholly owned subsidiary company of The Federal Bank Ltd, registered under Companies Act, 2013 on 26 October 2018. The company operates from Kakkanad, Kerala, Indore and Vishakhapatnam, [[Andhra Pradesh]].{{cite news |title=Fedserv |newspaper=The Hindu |date=29 August 2019 |url=https://www.thehindu.com/news/national/andhra-pradesh/fedserv-launches-operations-in-vizag/article29292568.ece}} *Fedbank Financial Services Ltd {{Cite web |title=Fedfina – Financial Institution for Gold loan, Home loans, Business & LAP online |url=https://fedfina.com/ |access-date=2024-01-09 |website=fedfina.com |language=en-gb}} – Fedfina is the non-banking financial arm of Federal Bank {{cite web |title=FedFina |url=https://www.icra.in/Rationale/ShowRationaleReport?Id=117733}} == Associate companies == *Ageas Federal Life Insurance Company Limited {{Cite web |title=Ageas Federal Life Insurance – Life Insurance Plans in India |url=https://www.ageasfederal.com/ |access-date=2024-01-09 |website=www.ageasfederal.com}} - Ageas Federal is a joint venture between Ageas Insurance International NV, a multinational insurance giant based out of Europe and Federal Bank. Federal Banks holds 26% stake in the company.{{cite web |title=Ageas Federal |url=https://www.moneycontrol.com/news/business/idbi-federal-life-insurance-renamed-as-ageas-federal-life-insurance-after-stake-sale-6291071.html}} *Equirus Capital Private Limited {{Cite web |title=Equirus Capital {{!}} Best Financial Services in India |url=https://www.equirus.com/ |access-date=2024-01-09 |website=www.equirus.com}} - Federal Banks holds 19.79% stake in the company.{{cite news |title=Equirus Capital |newspaper=The Hindu |date=13 February 2021 |url=https://www.thehindu.com/business/equirus-capital-eyes-double-digit-growth/article33832079.ece |last1=Mishra |first1=Lalatendu }} ==Board of Directors== Current Board of Directors{{cite web|title=The Federal Bank Key Personnel|url=http://www.federalbank.co.in/key-personnel|access-date=5 November 2014|archive-date=3 October 2015|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20151003231715/http://www.federalbank.co.in/key-personnel|url-status=dead}} are: * Elias George (Part-Time Chairman and Independent Director) * KVS Manian (Managing Director and CEO) * Siddhartha Sengupta (Independent Director) * CA Manoj Fadnis (Independent Director) * Sudarshan Sen (Independent Director) * Varsha Purandare (Independent Director) * Sankarshan Basu (Independent Director) * Ramanand Mundkur (Independent Director) * Harsh Dugar (Executive Director) * Venkatraman Venkateswaran (Executive Director) ==Corporate Social Responsibility== Federal Bank has instituted a public charitable trust by name Federal Bank Hormis Memorial Foundation {{Cite web |title=Fedbank Hormis Memorial Foundation {{!}} Federal Bank {{!}} India |url=https://www.federalbank.co.in/fedbank-hormis-memorial-foundation |access-date=2024-01-09 |website=www.federalbank.co.in |language=en-US}} to perpetuate the fond memory of late [[K. P. Hormis]], the founder of the bank. The trust is striving hard to inculcate in people better knowledge and awareness in the field of banking through training programmes, focused seminars, awards and so on. The trust and its activities were inaugurated by the then Union Finance Minister Shri. [[P. Chidambaram]] at [[Ernakulam]] on 18.10.1996. For Federal Bank, Corporate Social Responsibility (CSR) has been an inherited and inbuilt element of its culture from the day the bank was founded. The founder's values and ethos based on trust got embedded in the bank's policies and principles which reflect on its day-to-day business. CSR in Federal Bank began with the first act of cultivating banking habits in an agrarian society - to effectively utilise idle money for productive purposes. * Sanjeevani {{Cite web |title=Sanjeevani – United against Cancer |url=https://www.federalbank.co.in/sanjeevani-united-against-cancer |access-date=2024-01-09 |website=www.federalbank.co.in |language=en-US}} In October 2023, Federal Bank Hormis Memorial Foundation, News 18 Network, and Tata Trusts unveiled ‘Sanjeevani- United against Cancer’.{{cite web |title=Sanjeevani 2023 |date=27 September 2023 |url=https://www.cnbctv18.com/healthcare/news18-sanjeevani-cancer-initiative-tata-trusts-federal-bank-hormis-mansukh-mandaviya-lisa-ray-17890411.htm}} ‘Sanjeevani’ mission is to build awareness, encourage screening and testing for Cancer. Through this initiative, the bank aims to raise awareness of the prevention of cancer, helping individuals fight the social stigma associated with the disease and the hesitation to opt for early detection and diagnosis. In April 2021, News18 and Federal Bank Hormis Memorial Foundation partnered to uplift societal health through its reach across the country through 'Sanjeevani – A Shot Of Life',{{Cite web |title=Sanjeevani |url=https://www.moneycontrol.com/sanjeevani |access-date=2024-01-09}} India's largest private vaccination drive to boost COVID-19 vaccine awareness. The bank led the campaign across 1000 villages of 5 districts of 5 different states touching more than 24 Lakh lives.{{cite web |title=Sanjeevani 2021 |work=Firstpost |date=7 April 2021 |url=https://www.firstpost.com/india/sanjeevani-a-shot-of-life-network18-and-federal-banks-drive-to-raise-awareness-about-covid-19-vaccination-9500581.html}} * Federal Skill Academy {{Cite web |title=Press Release |url=https://www.federalbank.co.in/documents/10180/444236001/Federal%20Bank%20empowers%20women%20through%20its%20skill%20academy-%20Second%20batch%20of%20tailoring%20program%20commences |access-date=2024-01-09}} - The Federal Skill Academy (FSA) is a part of the Federal Bank Hormis Memorial Foundation's CSR initiative, aiming to contribute significantly to India's skilling ecosystem. The bank initiated the launch of its 5th and 6th Skill Academy in Chennai and Belagavi in October 2023. The existing 4 centres are in Kochi, Coimbatore, Faridabad and Kolhapur.{{cite web |title=Federal Skill Academy |url=https://www.newsexperts.in/federal-bank-offers-free-skill-development-course-to-girls-in-wayanad/}} * Federal Bank Hormis Memorial Foundation Scholarship – The bank has been offering scholarships since 2005 every year to deserving and needy students to pursue professional courses such as MBBS, Engineering, B Sc. Nursing, MBA, Agriculture (B.Sc.) including BSc (Hons) Cooperation and Banking with Agricultural Sciences conducted by Agriculture Universities under this foundation. * Speak for India {{Cite web |title=Speak for India Edition 2023-24 |url=https://speakforindia.com/ |access-date=2024-01-09 |website=speakforindia.com}} is another positive change in the realm of education, providing the youth of the country the biggest debating platform to voice their opinions. Over 2 Lakh students have benefitted from the same since 2014.{{cite news |title=Speak For India |newspaper=The Times of India |date=27 March 2023 |url=https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/city/chennai/speak-for-india-tamil-nadu-finals-is-here/articleshow/99020782.cms}} * Mission Mookkannoor {{Cite web|date=2023-10-19 |title=Federal Bank backs Mookkannoor to become India's cleanest pin-code on Founders' day |url=https://www.thehindubusinessline.com/money-and-banking/federal-bank-backs-mookkannoor-to-become-indias-cleanest-pin-code-on-founders-day/article67434231.ece |access-date=2024-01-09 |website=BusinessLine |language=en}} - Federal Bank has inaugurated a very significant initiative - Mookkannoor Mission under the Swachh Bharat Abhiyan. This initiative aims to transform the birthplace of the Founder Shri K P Hormis, into a clean and green village.{{cite news |title=Mookkannoor Mission |newspaper=The Hindu |date=18 October 2023 |url=https://www.thehindu.com/news/cities/Kochi/federal-bank-adopts-mookkannoor-village-in-ernakulam/article67434800.ece}} ==Recent awards and recognition== * Fortune India ranked Federal Bank among the Top 50 Future Ready Employers of India 2025.{{Cite web |last=India |first=Fortune |date=2025-03-24 |title=Future-ready workplaces: Where only the best rise and the rest fall behind |url=https://www.fortuneindia.com/enterprise/future-ready-workplaces-where-only-the-best-rise-and-the-restfallbehind/121156 |access-date=2026-02-23 |website=Fortune India |language=en}} * Feddy, the AI chat bot of the Bank, won the SKOCH Silver Award for its innovative feature - Conversational Banking at the 100th [https://summit.skoch.in/ SKOCH Summit]. * Federal Bank awarded the Best CSR Project – Health (Large Enterprises Category) for 'Sanjeevani' programme at the KMA Green Palm Sustainability Summit 2025.{{Cite web |title=Sanjeevani – United against Cancer |url=https://www.federal.bank.in/sanjeevani-united-against-cancer |access-date=2026-02-23 |website=Federal Bank |language=en-US}} * Federal Bank's innovative product Flash Pay Smart Keychain bagged the Best Payment Experience Award at the 11th Edition Payments Reloaded Industry Awards 2024. * Federal Bank bagged the Gender Equality Champion Award at the Bombay Chamber's Diversity, Equity and Inclusion (DEI) Awards 2024.{{Cite web |date=2024-04-19 |title=Bombay Chamber DEI Awards 2024 - Controversies == In March 2019, the supreme Court of India stayed a Bombay High Court Special Court order that had directed Federal Bank to pay ₹4 crore (plus 18% annual interest from 1992) to the widow of late stockbroker Harshad Mehta regarding an uncashed pay oder issued to a third party.https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/india/sc-stays-bombay-hc-order-directing-federal-bank-to-pay-rs-4-crore-to-harshad-mehta-wife/articleshow/68335316.cms In November 2023, the Reserve Bank of India imposed a monetary penalty of ₹30 lakh on Federal Bank for non-compliance with Know Your Customer (KYC) guidelines after an inspection revealed instances of issuing demand drafts without including the purchaser's name.https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/india/sc-stays-bombay-hc-order-directing-federal-bank-to-pay-rs-4-crore-to-harshad-mehta-wife/articleshow/68335316.cms In July 2026, the Ernakulam District Consumer Disputes Redressal Commission ordered Federal Bank to pay ₹1.25 lakh in compensation for deficiency in service after blocking an NRI customer's international debit card without prior notice, leaving him and his family stranded at an airport abroad despite having sufficient funds.https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/legal/news/bank-blocked-debit-card-without-notice-family-stranded-at-foreign-airport-gets-rs-1-25-lakh/articleshow/132728337.cms ==See also== {{Portal|Banks}}
